title: ANSI/SDI-NC1.
officialText:
0 Section 2.4B1. Replace Section 2.4B1 of ANSI/SDI-NC1.0 with the following:

General. The design of the concrete slabs shall be done in accordance with the ACI Building Code Requirements for Reinforced Concrete. The minimum concrete thickness above the top of the deck shall be 1½ inches (38 mm).
